name: Predictive Adaptive SDF Ray Marching
definition: A ray marching algorithm for SDF rendering that uses an adaptive step size based on the previous two distance estimates to predict the next step, with a reduction factor to prevent overshooting.
summary: Predictive Adaptive SDF Ray Marching is a ray marching algorithm that calculates step size using a prediction from the previous two distance estimates, enabling smoother convergence in empty space compared to standard adaptive methods.
